name: Tougou Masamune
source:
Tougou family’s eldest son.
An executive director at the family’s main corporate headquarters. Raised under strict discipline but in a warm household, he has a calm, well-balanced personality. Fond of Asuma and recognizes him as a capable leader for the next generation.

[Translated from [url=https://holicworks.net/24ku/mainchara.html]the official website[/url].]
